Definition: a variation of G899; depth, i.e. (by implication) the sea:--deep.
BiblicalUsage: bythós means the deep, the sea. It appears once, in 2 Corinthians among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bythós, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
